integrity: The existing rank-dependent upper bound is credited as prior literature. A new explicit equality family is proved for every integer n>=1. Finite exact-arithmetic checks supplement the all-rank proof; no independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: A constructive sharpness result for the dimension of the nearly backward-shift-invariant defect. It does not optimize the model-space dimension, classify other equality families, or establish a perturbation stability theorem. Publication priority is not independently verified.
title: Sharp \(2n+1\) backward-shift defects from projection-perturbed truncated Toeplitz shifts
